question: At the frozen independent-44 sampled state, midway between R30's failing independent-40 state and R29's exact independent-48 state, does the all-cardinality antipodal-pair relation law hold relative to that state's own full-five-coordinate membership?
hypothesis: Across all 32767 nonconstant complement-normalized binary partitions at independent-44, every one of the 32640 pair-splitting partitions will reproduce independent-44 full-five-coordinate membership in all four phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate panels, while all 127 pair-preserving partitions will match zero panels; no partition will be partial and every cardinality stratum 1 through 15 will have zero law mismatches.

prior_evidence.observation: At independent-40 all 32640 pair-splitting partitions matched all four panels, but 120 of 127 pair-preserving partitions matched all four and only seven matched zero; 120 partitions mismatched the prior law across seven cardinality strata, while the full-five-coordinate state had 24 classes, one intact alias triplet, and eight split alias triplets.

scope_statement: This changes exactly one R29 dimension: the frozen independent sampler record budget is decreased from 48 to the fixed midpoint 40 observations per surface between R28's failing 32 and R29's exact 48. Partition enumeration, complement normalization, antipodal-pair relation, four projections, exact membership comparison against the same state's full-five-coordinate classes, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.pair_relation: For each q in 0..7 compare bit(q) with bit(q+8). A partition is pair_preserving only when all eight agree and pair_splitting otherwise.
arms_and_inputs.combinatorial_cardinalities: Require exactly 127 pair-preserving and 32640 pair-splitting partitions; independently construct the 127 nonempty unions of antipodal pairs 1..7 and require exact set equality.
